subject: Intra-window billing smoothing request — storage add-on & ephemeral burst
messages:
From: Anita Shah <anita@cleardata.co>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@cleardata.co
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Request: smoothing charge for mid-month storage add-on and ephemeral burst

Hi Marcus,

Quick context: we spun up an extra storage add-on + short-lived GPU burst on June 22 to support a one-week data re-ingest. That resulted in a mid-cycle partial charge that tripped our AP workflow — our EU entity requires a consolidated invoice and VAT evidence, and our US entity prefers a single ACH for the month.

Can Redwood do an intra-window smoothing so the partial add-on charge is consolidated onto our July invoice as a single line item (with a note describing the June burst)? If not, can you provide:
- a corrected prorated invoice that shows the line-level VAT handling (reverse-charge vs. standard)
- the usage export for June (we need token/GB breakdowns for audit)
- the expected date for invoice issuance and whether a single ACH will be acceptable for both amounts

I've attached the SOW for reference (v2) — the finance team is on cc. We need to close this before our month-end on 7/12 so AP can schedule payment.

Thanks,
Anita Shah
Head of Finance, ClearData Analytics
Anita Shah | ClearData Analytics
attachments: ClearData_SOW_v2.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita@cleardata.co>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: smoothing charge for mid-month storage add-on and ephemeral burst

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear note and the SOW. Short answer: yes, we can accommodate a consolidation, but I need billing ops to confirm how VAT gets documented and whether we can delay the partial charge onto your July invoice without triggering a duplicate accounting event.

Lauren / Soojin — can you confirm the operational steps? My suggested approach:
1) Reverse the interim mid-June incremental invoice (if already issued) and issue a single July invoice that includes the prorated add-on + burst as one line with a reference note.
2) Produce a usage CSV with token/GB breakdown and a VAT treatment note per entity (US entity: standard; EU entity: reverse charge — confirm).
3) If ClearData prefers a single ACH on July 15, we can set payment terms accordingly; we may need a signed acceptance to avoid automatic collection on the interim invoice.

Anita — would you be okay signing a short one-page acknowledgement that Redwood should withhold auto-collection until the consolidated invoice (DocuSign is fine)?

I can escalate for a same-week turnaround if billing confirms.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Anita Shah <anita@cleardata.co>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: smoothing charge for mid-month storage add-on and ephemeral burst

Thanks Marcus / Anita — looping in billing ops details. We can do this, here’s the plan and caveats: 

Plan of action:
- If an interim invoice already posted for the June add-on, we will void that interim invoice and issue a consolidated July invoice with a single line item: "June 22–28 storage add-on & ephemeral GPU burst (prorated)". The consolidated invoice will include a short note with the original interim invoice number for audit traceability.
- We will attach a usage export (CSV) and a VAT notes appendix that indicates per-entity tax treatment.
- We will set the consolidated invoice issue date to July 10 and set due date July 25 to allow AP to schedule ACH.

Caveats / constraints:
- If ClearData requires the mid-June charge to be shown on a June AP ledger for internal compliance, consolidation will create a book timing difference. We can add an accounting memo but cannot change your internal cut-off. Please confirm if your AP team can accept the memo approach.
- For EU reverse-charge: we need ClearData’s VAT ID and confirmation of entity (which company will receive the invoice).

Attachments I will include when I generate the consolidated invoice: detailed usage_export_Jun2027.csv (token/GB per day) and a VAT appendix PDF.

Next steps for Anita: please confirm the billing entity and provide VAT ID (if EU reverse-charge applies), and confirm DocuSign acknowledgement for withholding auto-collection. Once we have that, I’ll create the void/issue request and share the DocuSign link.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
attachments: usage_export_Jun2027.csv

- Billing entity: ClearData Analytics, Inc. (US) — primary invoice to this entity. Our EU subsidiary (ClearData EU Ltd) will be the recipient of the VAT reverse-charge appendix for audit only; they will not be billed directly. VAT ID for EU subsidiary: GB987654321.
- AP can accept the memo (they prefer the consolidated invoice); please proceed to void the interim invoice and issue the consolidated July invoice.
- DocuSign acknowledgement is fine — please send; AP will sign quickly so we can schedule ACH on July 20.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please send the usage CSV and the consolidated invoice/DocuSign link.
